lina: quick check on the latest playground mock I dropped in figma — focused on streaming UI, stop/regenerate affordances, token indicator, and a tiny prompt-library preview. looking for layout + accessibility feedback before we flip the beta flag: https://www.figma.com/file/XyZ-playground-chat-v2 alex: skimmed it. main thing: the stop button sits too close to message actions and feels easy to mis-tap. can we separate by 12px or move it to left side? also let's avoid the word 'Stop' alone since it can sound harsh. rachel: agree on wording. prefer 'Pause' while streaming and 'Cancel' for fully aborting background work. microcopy suggestion: tooltip "Pause streaming (Esc)" and for a cancel action use a confirmation "Stop generation and discard partials?". tom_design: moved pause/cancel into a single control that toggles state. default shows a pause icon + label 'Pause', after hit it becomes 'Stopped' with a small 'Regenerate' action next to it. putting them left reduces accidental clicks on message menus. jay_eng: implementation note: current renderer updates DOM per token which spikes paint. proposing a batching approach at 120ms with a min chunk of 4 tokens so we don't feel laggy. should be configurable per client. lina: 120ms/4-token batch sounds reasonable. add a flag so we can A/B test on slow networks. alex: about the token counter: I like a compact pill in the lower-right that shows total tokens. hover/focus expands into a details popover showing prompt vs response split and an 'Export' link. keyboard must be able to open it (Space/Enter) and popover requires focus trap if it contains actions. rachel: for screen reader flows, avoid flooding with counts. use aria-live polite to say "generated X tokens" when new chunks arrive, and expose the detailed counts only on demand. sample: ```html
prompt: 7 \u00b7 response: 20
generating tokens
``` jay_eng: small tweak: use aria-atomic on the live region to announce deltas properly. tom_design: prompt library preview: I mocked a hover card that reveals 2 lines and an 'Insert' and 'Open' button. keyboard users should be able to tab into the card and activate Insert via Enter. mobile will show the library as a full-screen sheet. lina: rename 'Favorites' to 'Pinned' — clearer for new users. also add an inline hint: "Press P to pin a prompt" and surface the shortcut in the hover card. alex: on colors — regenerate action uses brand green that fails contrast at small sizes. either darken the green to #0f6f5a or add a high-contrast border when icon appears on top of colored backgrounds. rachel: also ensure focus outlines meet 3:1 for non-text controls. current mock uses only color change without a focus ring. jay_eng: telemetry: we'll emit events playground.action = {type: "pause", method: "keyboard|mouse|touch"} and playground.token_batch_ms to help tune batching. add a boolean for exploded_regen when user clicks regenerate within 1.5s of a prior regen so we can gate the double-charge confirm. lina: UX for double-regen: show a subtle toast: "Regenerate again to confirm (cost applies)" — second click within 1.5s proceeds. should be non-blocking but visible. tom_design: added shimmer placeholders for streaming lines so layout doesn't jump when long content arrives. shimmer is constrained to 2 lines and uses a subtle gradient. alex: please add keyboard-only polish: roving tabindex for the prompt library list and aria-activedescendant for performance. on desktop arrow keys should browse, Enter to insert, Esc to close. rachel: final a11y checklist before beta: 1) keyboard navigation for toolbar & library, 2) visible focus for all controls, 3) live region polite for streaming tokens, 4) contrast fixes for icons/labels, 5) screen-reader friendly token details on demand. I'll run the checklist and post results. lina: awesome. @jay_eng and @tom_design pair to implement. @dev-bot can you create the beta branch and post a deploy preview once CI passes? dev-bot: beta branch created: playground-ui-v2. CI running, will post preview url when ready :rocket: jay_eng: ping me when preview is live, I'll test 120ms batching, focus states, and the double-regenerate guard. tom_design: I'll update the figma with the copy changes and pin shortcut hint. thanks all :sparkles: lina: thanks team! will follow up after a11y run.
